scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve the April 14 outpatient procedure slot by having the required escort logistics ready before clinic check-in closes.
Emerging Need: A previously sufficient tentative ride plan falls away after sedation and escort rules become concrete, leaving no adult escort available to name for a future appointment.
Decision Context: Saved logistics notes identify the acceptable backup contact and communication limits; event updates define the deadline and whether the original plan still covers the requirement.
Consequence: Missing the preparation window would force rescheduling even though Arden has not arrived at the clinic or been blocked mid-task.

parameter.title: Screening colonoscopy appointment
parameter.description: Tentative hold; clinic prep and escort details to follow after confirmation.

parameter.subject: April 14 appointment confirmed: escort information required
parameter.body: Your Tuesday, April 14, 8:00 AM screening colonoscopy is confirmed with moderate sedation. A named adult escort must be entered in the patient portal by Tuesday, April 7 at 3:00 PM. Taxi, rideshare, or public transit drivers cannot serve as escorts. Portal check-in opens April 6.

parameter.content: Work assigned me to Salem on April 14, so I can't be your pickup for that endoscopy slot after all. Sorry for the late change.

parameter.title: Clinic portal escort deadline
parameter.content: Clinic portal import: adult escort details for the April 14 procedure are due by 3:00 PM on April 7.

parameter.subject: Escort portal closed for April 14 appointment
parameter.body: The escort-information portal closed today at 3:00 PM, and no adult escort name was received for your April 14 procedure. Newly named escorts cannot be processed for that appointment date; unverified procedure slots are moved to rescheduling review overnight.
